description: This file defines the Total class within the Opencart catalog model extension, specifically for handling total calculations in the shopping cart. It provides a method to get the total amount, updating the passed totals, taxes, and total variables, and loads language data for display purposes.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: A class that manages the calculation and addition of the total price in the cart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Adds the total amount to the totals array, including language and configuration data.
